import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Source0 schema: ['ComunaID', 'ComunaNombre', 'ProvinciaID']
# Source1 schema: ['ProvinciaID', 'ProvinciaNombre', 'RegionID']
# Target schema: ['ProvinciaID', 'ProvinciaNombre', 'RegionID', 'ComunaID', 'ComunaNombre']

# Join Source0 and Source1 on ProvinciaID to get ProvinciaNombre and RegionID for each Comuna
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_source0,
    df_source1,
    on="ProvinciaID",
    how="inner",
    validate="many_to_one"
)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df_merged[
    ['ProvinciaID', 'ProvinciaNombre', 'RegionID', 'ComunaID', 'ComunaNombre']
]

# Ensure data types match target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'ProvinciaID': 'int64',
    'ProvinciaNombre': 'string',
    'RegionID': 'int64',
    'ComunaID': 'int64',
    'ComunaNombre': 'string'
})

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index column
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
